desc: Read N and A from standard input.
Implement a brute-force game solver for small N and small A_i using state (remaining counts, opened mask) to compute exact winners.
Generate small cases and test the proposed parity-count rule; record any counterexamples and observed patterns.
Derive or verify a closed-form winner rule from brute-force results, paying attention to N=1,2,3, parity classes, pass moves, and the final-move truncation.
Implement an efficient O(N) solution based on the verified rule.
Test on samples and edge cases, including N=1, N=2, N=3, all odd, all even, and large A_i.
Print the winner to standard output.
